description: This file contains the trait 'DecryptionTraitV2' which provides methods for decrypting data using AWS SDK encryption mechanisms, including handling cipher options, validation, and stream creation for decryption.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts cipher text data using provided materials, envelope, and options. It sets up cipher options, retrieves the decryption key, validates options and envelope, and returns a decryption stream.

methods.name: getTagFromCiphertextStream
methods.description: Extracts the authentication tag from a cipher text stream based on the specified tag length.

methods.name: getStrippedCiphertextStream
methods.description: Removes the authentication tag from the cipher text stream to prepare for decryption.

methods.name: validateOptionsAndEnvelope
methods.description: Validates the cipher options and envelope headers against supported algorithms and schemas, throwing exceptions if unsupported or mismatched.

methods.name: getDecryptingStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a decryption stream based on cipher options and the provided ciphertext and key, supporting different cipher modes like GCM.
